texts.facts: The petitioner is the proprietor of Raj Hotel situated at TB Junction, Punalur is the submission. He is conducting the hotel business in the building bearing Door No.PMC 13/492, 13/492(2) and 13/492(4) of Punalur Municipality. Petitioner is running the hotel, after obtaining necessary license from the 1st respondent Municipality is 2026:KER:15172 the submission. License period is from 01.04.2022 to 31.03.2027 is the further submission. The petitioner has also obtained license under the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (FSS) from the Commissionarate of Food Safety and the same is valid upto 17.07.2027 is the further submission. It is submitted that the petitioner is running the hotel business complying all the conditions as per the licenses issued by the respective authorities. Now the 2 nd respondent issued Ext.P3 notice stating that the license of the petitioner's hotel has been obtained in the building bearing Door Nos.13/492, 13/492(2) and 13/492(4) and out of the same, Door No.13/492(4) is part of the supermarket conducted by the 4th respondent and hence the license is to be cancelled. The 3rd respondent is the brother of the petitioner and the 4th respondent is the son of the 3rd respondent. Respondent Nos.3 and 4 are not in good terms with the petitioner is the further submission. Moreover, it is also submitted that Ext.P3 is an order passed without giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. A perusal of the same would not show that it is an order passed after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. The counsel appearing for the party respondents submitted that it is an appealable order.
